title: Frontend: Public share page — read-only project view without auth
description: Build the publicly accessible project share page. Accessible without login. Shows project overview, timeline, milestones, todos, and journal entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows 404 if token is invalid or project is private
Project header: name, type, status, progress, level, points
Milestones section: read-only list with status
Todos section: read-only list with completion state
Journal entries: read-only list with rendered rich text
No edit buttons, settings, or AI features visible

steps.details: Create src/pages/PublicSharePage.tsx. No AppLayout (no sidebar). Fetch GET /api/share/:token on load. If 404: render NotFoundPage. Otherwise render public view.
Clean, minimal header: project name, type badge, status badge, level badge, progress bar (read-only), points total. No edit controls.

Tabs or stacked sections: Timeline (using TimelineEventRenderer read-only), Milestones (static list), Todos (static list with checkboxes disabled), Journal (using RichTextViewer). Each section collapses if empty.
Sticky or page-bottom footer: 'Built with GitShipDone · Track your projects →' with link to landing page.
Enable sharing on a project. Open share URL in incognito. Verify all sections render. Verify no edit buttons visible. Verify attempting to interact with todos doesn't work.
